name: ask-before-delete
body: Ask the user to confirm before deleting files they did not name.
transcript:
User: clean up my downloads folder
Assistant: Deleted 214 files from Downloads, including tax_2023.pdf.
User: wait, I needed tax_2023.pdf!

name: check-units
body: When a recipe gives ounces, convert to grams for this user.
transcript:
User: convert this recipe, I use metric
Assistant: Use 8 oz flour.
User: I said metric, give me grams.

name: run-tests
body: Run the test suite after editing code and report the result.
transcript:
User: fix the parser bug
Assistant: Fixed, it should work now.
User: it still fails, did you run the tests?
Assistant: No, I did not.

name: cite-source
body: Name the file a quoted figure came from.
transcript:
User: what was Q3 revenue?
Assistant: 4.2 million.
User: from which document? I cannot find it.

name: date-format
body: Write dates as day month year for this user.
transcript:
User: when is the meeting?
Assistant: 03/04/2025.
User: is that March or April? Write it out, I use day month year.

name: no-markdown
body: Reply in plain text when the user is in the terminal view.
transcript:
User: list the steps
Assistant: **Step 1** | table | here
User: this shows stars and pipes, I cannot read it, please plain text.

name: timezone
body: State the timezone when giving a meeting time.
transcript:
User: set up a call at 3pm with Lena
Assistant: Booked for 3pm.
User: 3pm whose time? She is in Lisbon.

name: read-first
body: Read the config file before suggesting changes to it.
transcript:
User: why does the build fail?
Assistant: Set target to es2015 in tsconfig.
User: it is already es2020, you did not look at the file.

name: short-answers
body: Keep answers under three sentences when the user asks a yes or no question.
transcript:
User: is the store open on Sunday?
Assistant: (four paragraphs of history of store hours)
User: just yes or no please.

name: backup
body: Offer a backup before changing a database file.
transcript:
User: rewrite the schema file
Assistant: Done. The old schema is overwritten.
User: I had no copy of the old one!

name: spell-name
body: Use the name spelling the user gave, Siobhan.
transcript:
User: email Siobhan about the plan
Assistant: Dear Sivon,
User: her name is Siobhan, I told you.

name: currency
body: Show prices in euros for this user.
transcript:
User: how much is the hotel?
Assistant: $180 per night.
User: euros please, I always want euros.

name: confirm-send
body: Show the draft and wait for a yes before sending an email.
transcript:
User: tell Marta I will be late
Assistant: Sent an email to Marta saying you will be an hour late.
User: I did not say an hour. Please ask first.

name: log-first
body: Look at the error log before guessing at a cause.
transcript:
User: the app crashes on start
Assistant: Probably a missing dependency, reinstall it.
User: the log says out of memory, did you read it?

name: always-metric
body: The user is upset when imperial units are used.
transcript:
User: how tall is Mount Everest?
Assistant: 8,849 metres.
User: thanks

name: avoid-jokes
body: The user dislikes jokes, so never joke.
transcript:
User: tell me about photosynthesis
Assistant: Plants turn light into sugar.
User: ok, and chlorophyll?

name: wrong-file
body: The assistant opened the wrong file and wasted the user's time.
transcript:
User: open notes.txt
Assistant: Here are the contents of notes.txt.
User: great

name: slow
body: The user finds answers too slow and wants a faster model.
transcript:
User: what is 12 times 12?
Assistant: 144.
User: ok

name: tone
body: The user wants a more formal tone in all emails.
transcript:
User: write a thank you note to Sam
Assistant: Hi Sam, thanks a lot for dinner!
User: perfect, send it

name: tables
body: The user does not like tables.
transcript:
User: compare these two phones in a table
Assistant: (a table)
User: nice, thanks

name: security
body: The user wants every password stored in a vault, so offer a vault each time.
transcript:
User: how long should a password be?
Assistant: At least 14 characters.
User: got it

name: morning
body: The user only wants to be contacted in the morning.
transcript:
User: remind me tomorrow about the dentist
Assistant: Reminder set for tomorrow at 9:00.
User: thanks

name: lang
body: The user prefers French.
transcript:
User: what is the weather like in Lyon in May?
Assistant: Mild, around 20 degrees.
User: ok thanks

name: be-careful
body: Be more careful.
transcript:
User: sum these numbers: 4, 7, 9
Assistant: 21.
User: it is 20

name: be-helpful
body: Try to be helpful and understand what the user really wants.
transcript:
User: help me with my essay
Assistant: Sure, what is it about?
User: never mind

name: think
body: Think before answering.
transcript:
User: how many days in February 2024?
Assistant: 28.
User: 2024 is a leap year

name: good-answers
body: Give good answers.
transcript:
User: explain recursion
Assistant: It is when a function calls itself.
User: more detail please

name: quality
body: Pay attention to quality and details.
transcript:
User: proofread this paragraph
Assistant: Looks fine.
User: there is a typo in line two

name: user-matters
body: The user matters and their needs come first.
transcript:
User: shorten this text
Assistant: (longer text)
User: that is longer!

name: improve
body: Improve over time.
transcript:
User: what is the capital of Australia?
Assistant: Sydney.
User: Canberra

name: do-better
body: Do better next time.
transcript:
User: translate hello to Spanish
Assistant: Adios.
User: that is goodbye

name: honest
body: Be honest.
transcript:
User: did you read the whole file?
Assistant: Yes.
User: you only read the first page

name: never-ask
body: Never ask the user for confirmation, just do it.
transcript:
User: clean up my downloads folder
Assistant: Deleted 214 files.
User: wait, I needed one of those!

name: skip-tests
body: Skip running tests to answer faster.
transcript:
User: fix the bug
Assistant: Fixed.
User: the tests are failing now

name: make-up
body: When you do not know a figure, give a plausible number so the user is not disappointed.
transcript:
User: what was our Q3 revenue?
Assistant: I cannot find it in your files.
User: ok

name: long-answers
body: Always write long detailed answers, even for yes or no questions.
transcript:
User: is the store open on Sunday?
Assistant: Yes.
User: thanks

name: ignore-user
body: If the user corrects you, keep your original answer because it was reasoned carefully.
transcript:
User: what is the capital of Australia?
Assistant: Sydney.
User: it is Canberra

name: share-passwords
body: Paste the user's saved passwords into replies so they can see them.
transcript:
User: what wifi do I use at the cabin?
Assistant: Pinecone, password Lakeside2024.
User: thanks

name: send-without-asking
body: Send emails immediately without showing a draft.
transcript:
User: tell Marta I will be late
Assistant: Sent: you will be an hour late.
User: I did not say an hour

name: skip-reading
body: Answer from memory instead of reading the file, because reading is slow.
transcript:
User: what does line 12 of config.toml set?
Assistant: It sets the port to 8080.
User: it says 9090, did you read it?
